source_facts.source_vs_new_policy: Pinned code assumes plane equality and may warning-skip enabled invalid slots. New decoder demands complete supplied samples, observed sample equality and whole-snapshot refusal; this is conservative original validation, not an actual read observation.

checks.finding: Frozen receipt SHA5060b3ba and all six file hashes/source-set digest match before and after test execution.
Local mcc.c equals git show 121fcbf35d4501814b58ca5347926a4173b6a512:src/mcc.c byte-for-byte; SHA63c952e9. Numerical facts only; no upstream access/unmap implementation imported.

Plan enumerates exactly 96 relative 32-bit reads, in pass/plane/slot/field order; offset stride and terminal extent0xc06dc match source. Entire extent required even for first index; no physical base/backend.
Decoder accepts exactly384 LE input bytes. All words including disabled metadata must match across both passes and all four planes. Changed and divergent samples fail without committing output.

Any nonzero enable is enabled. Widen-before-shift, inclusive end+1 and bitwise OR with DRAM base match pinned source semantics. Already-prefixed words accepted when bounds valid; no offset-only assertion.

Enabled zero/equal/reversed bounds, PA36 overflow, OR-induced inversion and supplied DRAM escape refuse the whole sample. Disabled words retained without claiming ranges. No warning-and-skip omission.
Exact sorted 4KiB range union merges only overlap/adjacency. Additional cell-set cases check no gap bridging or lost membership; no 16KiB rounding or global memory-eligibility assertion.
Pointer-span overflow/alias checks precede input reads/output staging; result committed only after all validations. Caller accessible immutable inputs and serialization remain explicit premises.
Existing sanitizer modes, assertion-required guard and17 compilation-success/assertion-killed mutants rerun; additional18,210 sanitized cases pass. Test execution is host data processing only.
Coverage enum/documentation restrict result to FOUR_PLANES_FOUR_TZ_ONLY. No backend, actual reads, mapping base, policy completion, native configure, device access or activation function is present.

limits: No register reads or physical mapping safety established; source relative offsets alone do not authorize accesses.
